SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_cents),0) AS total_cents,
       COALESCE(SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_cents),0) / 100.0 AS total_usd,
       COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM order_lines ol
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
WHERE o.customer_region = 'EMEA'
  AND o.status = 'closed';
